task.instruction: Find a hotel with 4 star and above rating in Los Angeles for 3 days from Dec 18th.

final_answer:
I searched Booking.com for Los Angeles from Fri, Dec 18 to Mon, Dec 21, 2026 (3 nights, 2 adults, 1 room) with the 4-star filter applied. The page lists 707 properties, and the results include some vacation rentals with similar quality ratings. Two of the top results:

- **InterContinental - Los Angeles Downtown by IHG** is in Downtown LA, 1.6 km from downtown. It scored 8.7 (Excellent) from 1,686 reviews. A Classic Queen Room with Two Queen Beds and City View costs MYR 3,355 for the 3 nights, plus MYR 544 in taxes. It is marked "Featured".
- **The Beverly Hilton** is in Beverly Hills, 15.7 km from downtown. It scored 7.4 (Good) from 339 reviews. It is marked "Ad", so it is a paid placement.

I didn't confirm the star rating on each hotel's own page, so the 4-star filter is my only basis for it. I didn't book anything. Of these two, the InterContinental has the higher guest score. You can browse the full list here: https://www.booking.com/searchresults.html?ss=Los+Angeles&checkin=2026-12-18&checkout=2026-12-21&group_adults=2&no_rooms=1&group_children=0&nflt=class%3D4%3Bclass%3D5

judge.rationale: The final page shows Los Angeles Dec 18–21, 2026 with 4-star filter checked and lists hotels such as InterContinental with 5-star icons and availability.
